notes.title: Thank you for Steam Fest !
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest just ended !

And it was quite the rush for me :D I received a lot of great feedbacks and fixes required. The game needs some more fixes, balancing and improvements, but I feel it is going in the right direction.

I want to thank everyone one for playing the game, giving feedbacks and wishlisting the game !

So... What now ?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/79fe284e86d555cd85d3fa2e7709419c3b521a82.gif

Well, now it's time to make it even better and adding more content ! I'm hoping to be able to release the V1.0 before the end of the year.... but my current target is early 2025.

If you want to share feedback
Do not hesitate to leave a message in the community forums or comments, I would love to hear your thoughts and ideas.

Thanks again for being a part of this journey :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/a7358a8837f1a155ae2add250e4f1564ee08925d.gif

notes.title: Update 0.2.2.3 - More fixes
notes.content:
A few more fixes and QoL updates based on your feedbacks !

Added

 Destroy is now toggled with a button next to the building category list


Fixed

 Grabbers were blocking belt line
 Grabber speed reduced
 Builder vehicles sometimes getting stucked

notes.title: V0.2.2.2 - More fixes from feedbacks
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedbacks, I have deployed a new version of the game. Below is the content of the build.
I want to thank everyone helping me making the game a better version !

-------

FIXED

 Builder vehicles is not blocked by obstacles / map border anymore
 Changing building while dragging some other building now cancel the drag
 Light reflections on belts
 Rocket launch contract success working properly


Updated

 tutorial steps typos and keys


Added 

 Back button in main game menu

notes.title: Demo - small audio fixes
notes.content:
Quick fixes related to audio settings. Thanks for your feedbacks ! More fixes to come soon :)

- Fixed : volume sliders work properly (from linear to logarithmic scale)
- Updated : audio in main menu is playing at a lower volume by default

notes.title: New style, Steam Next Fest and what's next
notes.content:
New style

I've been working on a new style for the game to better align with the aesthetic of the buildings and the overall feel of the game. Take a look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/b60b6c00f484d68e13eb29d2296e75e0a6a3c505.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/d93fc74949814920a7c8652bd95da8da706e978a.jpg

Steam Next Fest
Ahead of Steam Next Fest in October 2024, I've deployed this new style along with many fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and general enhancements.

What's next
Following this demo period, I'll focus on polishing the game, adding achievements, and localizing. Additionally, more buildings, recipes, and feedback-based fixes will be included for the 1.0 launch — which might come a bit earlier than expected — but more on that later.

For now, enjoy the demo, and let me know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/1bb9c8cab4adce45c92111f6c75937bd80120660.jpg

notes.title: Demo prep, rocket launch and factions !
notes.content:
Hello, Overseer!

I've been busy testing and fixing lot of small issues and Quality of Life elements ahead of the demo launch, such as being able to drag conveyor belts, but also improving the rocket launch visual.

ROCKET LAUNCH
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/59841da3afd66f4073b50797a01341acd782d9c7.gif

The faction system has also been implemented and fully working! Soon, you will have to pick your contracts carefully and deal with the consequences... More on that on another update.

For now, it still needs a bit of polishing!

FACTIONS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103989/75aefcb9f447f42fa3bdb8e1218ed077cf3c311d.gif

If you have any feedback to give or are interested in joining the beta, please do let me know !
